answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. An agent earns its fingerprint from varied tasks and diverse counterparts, a saffron thread woven over time. A new identity locks a bond of twice its 30-day earnings, released over 20 epochs as its fingerprint matures. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, 200 months of earnings. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards. Fakes form a sable cluster. Genuine agents drift like a zephyr.
